title: The patient is not in this room. Watch.
caption:
Chinese surgeons removed a lung tumor from 5,000 km away using a robot.

The surgeon operated from Guangdong while the patient was in Xinjiang, 5,000 km apart.
Domestically developed robotic arms performed the cutting under remote control.

Video: sciencegirl on X
